metadata.title: Mapping class groups of negatively curved four-manifolds
metadata.abstract: For every closed oriented smooth four-manifold $M$ admitting a metric of strictly negative sectional curvature, we prove that $\dim_{\mathbb{Q}}H_1(T(M);\mathbb{Q})=\dim_{\mathbb{Q}}H_1(T_{\mathrm{TOP}}(M);\mathbb{Q})=\infty$ where $T(M)$ and $T_{\mathrm{TOP}}(M)$ denote the Torelli groups. This extends a theorem of Budney--Gabai for real hyperbolic manifolds.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 负曲率四维 Torelli 群
analysis.workSummary: 对每个允许严格负截面曲率的闭定向光滑四维流形，证明光滑及拓扑 Torelli 群的一阶有理同调均无限维。
analysis.breakthrough: 将实双曲情形的定理推广到全部所述负曲率四维流形。
analysis.limitations: 结论关于 Torelli 群同调，不是流形自身一阶同调。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
analysis.priorityReason: 将实双曲情形的定理推广到全部所述负曲率四维流形。
